metadata.title: When I aimed at nothing and somehow got 2 kills? Valorant must be broken again
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get handed 2 kills for doing basically nothing?
Enemy must’ve been playing hide-and-seek... and lost.
Click if your aim’s a mystery but the scoreboard’s lit.
Valorant logic: peak chaos.

Tap if your best kills come from pure accident chaos!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
